templates.title: Learn a subject
templates.description: Build a clear foundation in a topic and practice the first useful skills.
templates.promise: Build a durable foundation through guided practice and review
templates.when_to_use: The learner wants to understand a subject and has no fixed exam or artifact yet.
quality_rules: Every activity maps to at least one objective or skill.
Every incorrect diagnostic or practice response has an explanation.
The first session is bounded by the learner's available time.
The application activity asks the learner to use the idea, not only recall it.
The recommendation names one primary next action and its evidence.

templates.title: Prepare for an exam
templates.description: Turn an exam target into a focused practice and review loop.
templates.promise: Build an exam-ready understanding through guided practice and review
templates.when_to_use: The learner names an exam, certification, syllabus, or target score.
quality_rules: Every question maps to an exam objective.
Practice and timed practice are visibly different modes.
Every incorrect response has an explanation and review target.
The first session states its estimated effort and exam purpose.
Recommendations prioritize the weakest evidenced objective.

templates.title: Build a project
templates.description: Learn a practical skill by producing a concrete artifact in small milestones.
templates.promise: Learn the concepts and produce a working first project
templates.when_to_use: The learner names a project, artifact, workflow, or practical outcome.
quality_rules: Every milestone maps to an objective or skill.
The first milestone is small enough to complete in the planned session.
The learner receives feedback on the artifact or application attempt.
The journey distinguishes learning evidence from merely declaring completion.
The recommendation names the next milestone and its reason.
